scope: Representative-object benchmark only; no Dataset B rebuild, model retraining, production-code change, or real-scene batch run.

benchmark_summary.timing_interpretation: For this face-by-face rasterizer, representative timings are dominated by face traversal; they do not establish that coarser grids are materially cheaper.

model_performance_by_resolution.0.5_mm: Existing Dataset B test result: MAPE 5.8326%, R2 0.9845.
model_performance_by_resolution.1_to_50_mm: NOT AVAILABLE. A valid Test MAPE/RMSE/R2 comparison requires resolution-matched feature generation for all fixed-split samples and model training/selection at each resolution. This was intentionally not run after the representative benchmark demonstrated feature degeneration and empty surfaces at 25/50 mm.

production_scale_context.point_cloud_spacing: NOT AVAILABLE from the limited existing metadata search; no full point-cloud processing was performed.

conclusions.resolution_robustness: Not demonstrated. The same objects show material feature changes by 5-10 mm, and 25/50 mm return no surface with the training rasterizer.
conclusions.candidate_qualification: 10 mm is a scale-matched candidate for a future controlled production study because it matches the known DOM pixel size. It is not a final recommendation until point-cloud spacing and resolution-matched validation are established.
conclusions.existing_v2_direct_production_use: Not supported. The 0.5 mm-trained model must not be applied to 10 mm or 50 mm descriptors without resolution-matched validation/training.
conclusions.next_model_strategy: Build a new fixed-split, resolution-matched dataset at a production-supported resolution (initial candidate 10 mm) and train a new model; subsequently evaluate multi-resolution training only if it improves cross-resolution stability.
